Terraform apply complete. Next steps:
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

1. Run '.necessary' on all 4 pve nodes

2. Run .nec2 on runner-01
    
3. ssh from runner-01 into all nodes to accept new fingerprint
    
4. Verify all LXCs are reachable:
   ansible all -i ../ansible/inventory/hosts.yml -m ping

5. Run the Ansible site playbook to configure all nodes:
   cd ../ansible
   ansible-playbook playbooks/site.yml

debian_template.description: Debian 12 CT template filename in Proxmox template storage.

ip_controller.description: Static IP with CIDR for controller-01. Example: 192.168.1.202/24

ip_vault.description: Static IP with CIDR for vault-01. Example: 192.168.1.201/24

ip_worker_app.description: Static IP with CIDR for worker-02. Example: 192.168.1.204/24

ip_worker_infra.description: Static IP with CIDR for worker-01. Example: 192.168.1.203/24

network_bridge.description: Proxmox network bridge to attach all LXCs to.

network_dns.description: DNS server IP for all LXCs. Update to TechnitiumDNS IP once deployed.

node_controller.description: Proxmox node name to host the Ansible Controller LXC.

node_vault.description: Proxmox node name to host the Vault LXC.

node_worker_app.description: Proxmox node name to host Worker 2 (app) LXC.

node_worker_infra.description: Proxmox node name to host Worker 1 (infra) LXC.

proxmox_api_token_id.description: Proxmox API token ID in format: USER@REALM!TOKENNAME

proxmox_api_token_secret.description: Proxmox API token secret value. Never commit this value.

proxmox_api_url.description: Full URL to the Proxmox API endpoint. Use the cluster VIP if available.

proxmox_tls_insecure.description: Skip TLS verification. Set true only for self-signed certs in dev.

storage_controller.description: Storage pool name on the Controller node.

storage_vault.description: Storage pool name on the Vault node.

storage_worker_app.description: Storage pool name on the App Worker node.

storage_worker_infra.description: Storage pool name on the Infra Worker node.

template_storage.description: Storage pool where CT templates are stored (usually 'local').
